note: glm53-rtx3090-55g-nvx4 (v4.1-nvme image) on a 5950X / 2-channel DDR4 / x8 / one x2 NVMe box with a 90 GiB container cap. Measured, below the local-ai-registry 15 tok/s C1 gate, so not proposed as a registry candidate. Budget: ram_gb is the docker cap in GB (90 GiB); runtime_gb = the engine's rcs reserve 4 GiB + margin 3 GiB + prefill ring 1.69 GiB, other_gb = process memory when the tier is sized (5.89 GiB) rounded so the simulated RAM tier matches the engine-reported 8547 slots. lane_overrides are the pre-run estimates used for the prediction in the run record: zerocopy = 9,474,048 B / 13.5 GB/s, cpu = 0.25 ms/expert guessed for 13 lane threads at 3.4 GHz on 2-channel DDR4 (not measured; see calibration.derived).

measured.source: engine startup log (nv2 RAM tier, post-warm)

calibration.source: copied from glm53-rtx3090-55g-nvx4 (G067, EPYC + x16); not measured on this box

derived.label: DERIVED, not measured: from the 90 GiB run's kit C1 10.95 tok/s with per-token ms = fixed 14 + cpu lane, holding the sim's lane split (arithmetic in runs/omarchy-gpu-glm53-v41-nvme-90g.json sim.derived_cpu_per_expert_ms). Not applied in lane_overrides, so `sim` still reproduces the recorded prediction; try it with --set 'lane_overrides={"zerocopy":{"per_expert_ms":0.7},"cpu":{"per_expert_ms":0.48}}'.
